recipe.criteria: Supine cross-body glute/piriformis stretch: keep opposite leg straight, bring bent knee toward opposite shoulder while supporting outside knee and ankle with hands; head and back remain supported.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Eight-second video illustrates a gentle static hold.
